scientific_integrity: Exact theorem supported by the written argument; finite computations are corroboration only. No claim of independent review or novelty certification is made.
scientific_limitations: The formula covers primes at least five and shifts n for which p does not divide n(1+64n). Singular residue classes, prime 2 or 3, global integral-solvability statements, and elementary evaluation of individual elliptic traces are excluded.
title: Elliptic-curve traces govern generic odd-prime triangular-product square densities
